profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at RentSpree - Java | React | TypeScript | JavaScript
profile.summary:
I’m a passionate Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building robust solutions that make an impact. From leading complex projects with tight deadlines to mentoring junior developers, I thrive in dynamic environments where I can solve tough challenges and collaborate with great teams.

Currently, I'm at RentSpree working to enhance the rental experience for renters, landlords, and agents. No more paper applications and faxing! Previously, I spent time at Mark43, Tyler Technologies, and Avercast LLC, where I led architectural redesigns, built cross-product integrations, optimized performance for large-scale applications, and helped develop the first fully cloud-native records management system for police departments. I’ve always enjoyed diving into new areas of a codebase, whether it’s transforming a legacy system or creating a sleek, intuitive UI.

Technical Skills: Java, C#, .NET, React, Typescript, Angular 2+, JavaScript, SQL Server, MySQL, Docker, Git

Outside of coding, I’m passionate about mentoring and knowledge sharing, helping teams grow and work more efficiently. Whether it’s through pair programming, code reviews, or improving documentation, I aim to make a positive impact on the people I work with.

Let’s connect if you’re looking for someone with both technical expertise and a collaborative spirit!
